//: Versions are PINNED deliberately. `npx -y pkg` without a version resolves to
latest on every launch, which auto-installs unreviewed code — the exact shape
of the SmartLoader incident (Feb 2026), where a trojanized MCP server in a
legitimate registry exfiltrated API keys and SSH keys.
Pins are also the change-detection mechanism: a tool definition cannot change
under you without a visible diff to this file.
Every server here must pass references/mcp-catalogue.md § Vetting before it is
added, and adding an unvetted server requires skills/override (Tier B).
Bump versions deliberately, re-vetting on each bump.

context7.//: Current library docs. Read-only, no repo access. Vetted 2026-08-29.

playwright.//: Browser automation for dashboard E2E. Vetted 2026-08-29. NOTE: can reach arbitrary URLs — treat page content as untrusted (security S1).

memory.//: Cross-session knowledge graph. Vetted 2026-08-29. NOTE: persists model-authored content — see security S5 on memory poisoning.

sequential-thinking.//: Structured multi-step reasoning. No I/O. Vetted 2026-08-29.
